elaine: Thanks for the attendance today — super useful live Q&A. Starting this thread to collect the outstanding asks, owners, and links. I9ll ping owners in a few hours for status.

deploy-bot: Recording + slides: https://redwood.cloud/ah/1765439999/recording · Slides: https://drive.redwood/teams/all-hands/1765439999/slides · Transcript uploaded.

lucas: Quick clarification on Dedicated pricing tiers asked during Q&A: we are exploring two SKU tiers (standard / enterprise) with committed discounts. I9ll work with finance + sales to publish a strawman pricing grid. Owner: lucas. ETA: 2024-05-08.

priya: Question about private deployment install matrix — we9ll publish supported OS images, K8s versions, and an install checklist. Owner: priya (infra). ETA: 2024-05-02.

kelsey: On audit logs and KMS: customers asked for per-tenant key rotation guidance. I9ll add rotation examples + HSM notes to the security runbook. Owner: kelsey. ETA: 2024-05-06.

ananya: Eval/regression ask — we will add a customer-prompt sampling option to nightly evals and attach an incident playbook for quality regressions. Owner: ananya. ETA: 2024-05-04.

devex: SDK question — we9ll keep semver guarantees and publish a compatibility test harness + migration snippets (py/ts). Owner: devex. ETA: 2024-04-30.

elaine: I created a follow-up doc in the drive with links. Please check the owners/ETAs and flag if anything looks off.

lucas: Action items I put in the follow-up doc (copied here):
```\n- Lucas: Dedicated pricing strawman + discount tiers (due 2024-05-08)\n- Priya: Private deploy supported matrix + install checklist (due 2024-05-02)\n- Kelsey: KMS/key-rotation examples + HSM notes (due 2024-05-06)\n- Ananya: nightly eval + incident playbook for regressions (due 2024-05-04)\n- Devex: SDK compat harness + migration snippets (due 2024-04-30)\n```

priya: I9ll open a repo board and link infra owners for the private deploy matrix today.

kelsey: Adding a short RFC for KMS rotation patterns; will link doc here when ready.

ananya: First nightly run scheduled for 2024-04-29; will post metrics and alert thresholds.

devex: Starting the compat harness; will share an internal release candidate for folks to try.

elaine: If you asked a Q in the live session and don9t see it reflected here, reply or DM me and I9ll route it to the right owner. Also call out any blockers to ETAs — we9ll re-prioritize if needed. Thanks everyone for the quick follow-up! :sparkles:
